Home Pedals About Reviews Contact Shop on Reverb! $ 0.00 0 items Home / Overdrive / Tone Boner $ 149.00 Tone Boner quantity Add to cart Category: Overdrive Description Additional information Description Our take on the popular MOSFET boost that is so transparent no one would ever guess you’re using a pedal. More than simply boosting your guitar’s signal, Tone Boner actively restores clarity and tone from all that can get lost in that spaghetti of cables and effects. Added at the end of your signal chain, you’ll be astonished how your entire rig seems to suddenly come alive. Tone Boner features: Transparent boost adding clarity to your signal Dual outputs can split your signal to multiple amps Control for Stroke (amount of boost) Fully hand-wired analog circuitry Compact MXR-sized enclosure True bypass 3PDT switching Bright indicator LED 9V DC battery included NOW SHIPPING Worldwide Delivery Available! *All product names used in this webpage are trademarks of their respective owners, which are in no way associated or affiliated with Big Knob Pedals. Ben Poole is a longtime friend of Big Knob Pedals and uses our Tube808 and Tone Boner to overdrive his Cornford amps as well as having our Vibe Tone, Octavius, and Color Jumbo Fuzz as critical components to his current onstage and studio rig. Check out this live video of Ben doing what he does best at this year’s European Blues Challenge. Ben’s debut album “Let’s Go Upstairs” features some of the best new blues guitar performances along with astonishing tone! If you haven’t already, go check it out!
